title: Non-poison pest patrol sheet
summary: Controls garden pests through observation, isolation, airflow, cleanliness, and records before chemicals.
content: Non-poison pest patrol sheet is a practical offline routine for pest management. Inspect undersides of leaves, stems, soil surface, stored seeds, and compost edges on a schedule. Record pest type if known, plant, date, weather, damage level, and spread. Isolate affected containers before the whole garden is involved. Improve airflow, spacing, water timing, and cleanliness before considering treatment. Do not mix unknown chemicals or spray edible plants without reliable instructions.
steps: Isolate affected containers before the whole garden is involved.
